spec.title: About this view

options.content:
Where does the path from the router through FRR/Cilium to a service fail?

Missing or partial evidence is Unknown. [Runbook](https://github.com/iT3E/tnwks-ops/blob/main/docs/network/architecture.md)

spec.description: Purpose, scope and the interpretation of missing evidence.

spec.title: Site path probes
spec.description:
Cross-site probe success from each observer. Read with transport and endpoint evidence; a BGP Established session alone is insufficient.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Site tunnel traffic
spec.description:
Received on the router's WireGuard interface for each site's distro. Missing series mean the router isn't observed, not an idle tunnel.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Router interface errors
spec.description:
Router receive errors by interface. Telemetry enables are integrated after the network migration release.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Path by hop
spec.description:
Per site: the WireGuard tunnel to the router (handshake within 180 s), the router's BGP session with the distro's FRR, the Cilium agents' sessions with the distro, and the mesh (the site's agents and its KVStoreMesh both have the other cluster ready). Unknown when the router or the agents aren't observed.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Shared VIP routes
spec.description:
Which site the router sends each shared VIP to (1): the preferred site while its BGP session is up, else the other. Inferred from the router's live sessions and the declared local preference, not read from its route table. A client behind a site (its pods, the WSL host) reaches that site's own ingress either way.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Routes received per site
spec.description:
Prefixes the router accepted from each site's FRR (its node, pod and shared-VIP routes). Zero with an established session means the site announces nothing.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Cilium drops
spec.description:
Agent drop counters, with bounded labels. Cilium metrics activation belongs to the post-network-release integration.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Mesh connectivity
spec.description:
Each Cilium agent's readiness for the other cluster, through its own site's KVStoreMesh cache.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: KVStoreMesh remote cluster
spec.description:
Whether the site's clustermesh-apiserver (KVStoreMesh) has the other cluster's state synchronized. While it's down, agents keep serving the last cached state.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Mesh sync errors
spec.description:
KVStoreMesh errors writing the other cluster's nodes, services and identities into the local cache. Any is worth a look; persistent ones leave stale cross-site endpoints.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Mesh remote failures
spec.description:
KVStoreMesh connection failures to the other cluster since its last restart.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Router BGP session resets
spec.description:
Times each of the router's BGP sessions restarted in the range: its uptime went back. A session that dropped and came back between scrapes still counts. Only site 1 observes the router.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Cilium BGP session changes
spec.description:
State changes of each node's Cilium BGP session with its distro's FRR in the range. Sampled at each scrape, so a shorter flap can be missed.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Path hop changes
spec.description:
State changes of each path hop (tunnel, router BGP, agents, mesh) per site in the range, sampled at each rule evaluation.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.
